purpose: Secondary review of whether a returned finding actually identifies the reference defect, rather than merely producing any alert. Adds no source labels, input changes, prompt changes or tuning.
timing: Defined after 39 initial corpus results, when several nominally detected cases described normal seams or raw cut boundaries instead of the reference tear/abrasion. This is explicitly secondary post-output adjudication, not a preregistered blinded primary metric.
cases: All 75 reference-positive images, including those with no findings. Review against the unchanged image and frozen label, not against filenames.

categories.matched: At least one finding describes the visible reference break, fraying or coating loss; classify wrong type or invented anatomy separately.
categories.partial: The suspicious region is noticed but described ambiguously or as a different material mechanism; requires correction.
categories.missed: No returned finding identifies the visible reference defect, even if another normal feature triggers an alert.
categories.unscorable: No completed model output or insufficient basis for a reliable correspondence decision.

reviewer: Assistant visual review; not independent expert adjudication.
reporting: Keep primary any-flag detection, type agreement and this correspondence review separate. Do not add overlapping failures into one total.
